startingCard.title: William Shakespeare dies
startingCard.subtitle: English playwright and poet
startingCard.fact: William Shakespeare was an English playwright, poet and actor.

cards.title: ‘Green Book’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Peter Farrelly
cards.fact: Green Book is a 2018 American biographical comedy-drama film directed by Peter Farrelly.

cards.title: ‘Animal Crossing: City Folk’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Entertainment Analysis & Development
cards.fact: Animal Crossing: City Folk, released as Animal Crossing: Let's Go to the City in PAL territories, is a 2008 social simulation game developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii console and the third game in the Animal Crossing series.

cards.title: John Adams becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: John Adams was a Founding Father and the second president of the United States from 1797 to 1801.

cards.title: ‘Inferno’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Dante Alighieri
cards.fact: Inferno is the first part of the Italian writer Dante Alighieri's 14th-century narrative poem The Divine Comedy, followed by Purgatorio and Paradiso.

cards.title: Battle of Mons Graupius takes place
cards.subtitle: Battle in Roman conquest of Britain
cards.fact: The Battle of Mons Graupius was, according to Tacitus, a Roman military victory in what is now Scotland, taking place in AD 83 or, less probably, 84.

cards.title: 2S7 Pion enters service
cards.subtitle: Soviet self-propelled artillery
cards.fact: The 2S7 Pion ("peony") or 2S7M Malka is a Soviet self-propelled 203 mm cannon.

cards.title: ‘Interstellar’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Christopher Nolan
cards.fact: Interstellar is a 2014 epic science fiction film directed by Christopher Nolan, who co-wrote the screenplay with his brother Jonathan Nolan.

cards.title: Nusretiye Mosque is completed
cards.subtitle: Mosque in İstanbul, Turkey
cards.fact: The Nusretiye Mosque is an ornate mosque located in Tophane district of Beyoğlu, Istanbul, Turkey.

cards.title: Straits Settlements is established
cards.subtitle: Colony
cards.fact: The Straits Settlements were a group of British territories located in Southeast Asia.

cards.title: ‘The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Starbreeze Studios
cards.fact: The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay is a 2004 action-adventure stealth game developed by Starbreeze Studios and Tigon Studios and published by Vivendi Universal Games.

cards.title: Browning Hi-Power enters service
cards.subtitle: American-Belgian semi-automatic pistol
cards.fact: The Browning Hi-Power or 1935 Browning 9mm GP or Grand Puissance pistol is a single-action, semi-automatic pistol available in the 9×19mm Parabellum and.40 S&W calibers.

cards.title: People's Socialist Republic of Albania is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The People's Socialist Republic of Albania was the communist state that existed in Albania from 10 January 1946 to 29 April 1991.

cards.title: Saddam Hussein dies
cards.fact: Saddam Hussein was an Iraqi politician and revolutionary who served as the fifth president of Iraq from 1979 until his overthrow in 2003 during the United States-led invasion of Iraq.

cards.title: ‘The Great Bathers’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Pierre-Auguste Renoir
cards.fact: Les Grandes Baigneuses, or The Large Bathers, is a painting by Pierre-Auguste Renoir made between 1884 and 1887.

cards.title: Real Madrid Club de Fútbol is founded
cards.subtitle: Football club
cards.fact: Real Madrid Club de Fútbol, commonly referred to as Real Madrid, is a Spanish professional association football club based in Madrid.

cards.title: Charles IX of France becomes king of France
cards.fact: Charles IX was King of France from 1560 until his death in 1574.

cards.title: John, King of England becomes king of England
cards.fact: John was King of England from 1199 until his death in 1216.

cards.title: ‘Streets of Rage’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game
cards.fact: Streets of Rage is a 1991 beat 'em up video game developed and published by Sega for the Sega Genesis.

cards.title: Sukhoi Su-25 first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Sukhoi
cards.fact: The Sukhoi Su-25 Grach is a subsonic, single-seat, twin-engine jet aircraft developed in the Soviet Union by Sukhoi.

cards.title: Miyamoto Musashi dies
cards.subtitle: Japanese swordsman, philosopher, strategist, writer, artist, and rōnin
cards.fact: Miyamoto Musashi was a Japanese swordsman, strategist, artist, and writer who became renowned through stories of his unique double-bladed swordsmanship and undefeated record in his 62 duels.

cards.title: Yom Kippur War begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The Yom Kippur War, also known as the 1973 Arab–Israeli War, the fourth Arab–Israeli War, the October War, or the Ramadan War, was fought from 6 to 25 October 1973 between Israel and a coalition of Arab states led by Egypt and Syria.

cards.title: Tahmasp II becomes Safavid shah
cards.fact: Tahmasp II was the penultimate Safavid shah of Iran, ruling from 1722 to 1732.

cards.title: Emperor Yuan of Han becomes Emperor of China
cards.fact: Emperor Yuan of Han, personal name Liu Shi, was an emperor of the Chinese Han dynasty.

cards.title: Sidney Poitier dies
cards.subtitle: Bahamian and American actor and diplomat
cards.fact: Sidney Poitier was a Bahamian-American actor, film director, activist, and diplomat.

cards.title: ‘Sid Meier's Colonization’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by MicroProse
cards.fact: Sid Meier's Colonization is a turn-based strategy video game by Brian Reynolds and Sid Meier.

cards.title: Mungo Park dies
cards.subtitle: Scottish naturalist and explorer of the African continent
cards.fact: Mungo Park was a Scottish explorer of West Africa.

cards.title: ‘Little Women’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Greta Gerwig
cards.fact: Little Women is a 2019 American period drama film written and directed by Greta Gerwig.

cards.title: ‘The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Entertainment Analysis & Development
cards.fact: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening is a 1993 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy.

cards.title: Leopold Mozart dies
cards.subtitle: German composer
cards.fact: Johann Georg Leopold Mozart was a German composer, violinist, and music theorist.

cards.title: ‘Ray Donovan’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American crime drama television series
cards.fact: Ray Donovan is an American crime drama television series created by Ann Biderman for Showtime.
